data.description: 获取comm_max_stream参数推荐值。current_value为DN实际comm_max_stream值。recommended_value为根据当前环境规格计算出的DNcomm_max_stream参数的最大推荐值，取小于通过公式计算出的具体值calculated_value的1024的整数倍。
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT pgxc_node_str() AS node_name, (select setting from pg_settings where name = 'comm_max_stream') AS current_value, LEAST( ({cpu_nums} / {dn_nums})^2 * 2 * 20, ((SELECT setting::FLOAT FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_process_memory') * 1024) * 0.005 / ((SELECT setting::FLOAT FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_coordinators') + (SELECT setting::FLOAT FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'comm_max_datanode')) / 380.0, 8192 ) AS calculated_value, GREATEST( FLOOR(calculated_value / 1024) * 1024, 1024) AS recommended_value LIMIT 5;

data.description: 查看当前动态内存上下文详细信息。
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT contextname, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 totalsize_mb, sum(freesize)/1024/1024 freesize_mb, count(*) sum FROM {view_name} GROUP BY contextname ORDER BY totalsize_mb DESC LIMIT 20;

data.description: 在分布式CN进程上查询当前动态内存上下文信息。
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT pgxc_node_str(),contextname, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 totalsize_mb, sum(freesize)/1024/1024 freesize_mb, count(*) sum FROM {view_name} GROUP BY contextname ORDER BY totalsize_mb DESC LIMIT 20;

data.description: 在分布式主DN进程上查询当前动态内存上下文信息。
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT pgxc_node_str(),contextname, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 totalsize_mb, sum(freesize)/1024/1024 freesize_mb, count(*) sum FROM {view_name} GROUP BY contextname ORD}ER BY totalsize_mb DESC LIMIT 20;

data.description: 集中式查询临时文件落盘的SQL
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT extract(epoch from current_timestamp-query_start) AS query_runtime, query_start,pid,sessionid,datname, usename, state,query_id,unique_sql_id, substring(query, 0, 100) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid in(SELECT DISTINCT substring(name FROM 'pgsql_tmp(\d+)\.') FROM pg_ls_tmpdir()) ORDER BY query_runtime DESC LIMIT 20;

data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT table_name,pg_size_pretty(table_size) AS table_size FROM (SELECT schemaname||'.'||tablename as table_name,pg_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) as table_size FROM pg_tables ORDER BY table_size DESC LIMIT 20);

data.description: 分布式查询临时文件落盘的SQL
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT get_nodename(),extract(epoch from current_timestamp-query_start) AS query_runtime, query_start,pid,sessionid,datname, usename, state,query_id,unique_sql_id, substring(query, 0, 100) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid in(SELECT DISTINCT substring(name FROM 'pgsql_tmp(\d+)\.') FROM pg_ls_tmpdir()) ORDER BY query_runtime DESC LIMIT 20;

data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT datname,pg_size_pretty(database_size) database_size FROM (SELECT datname,pg_database_size(datname) database_size FROM pg_database ORDER BY database_size DESC) LIMIT 20;

data.description: 查询各DN分片占用stream连接的TOP SQL信息。
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT r.node_name,a.datname, a.usename,a.unique_sql_id, max(extract(epoch from current_timestamp-query_start)) AS max_query_runtime, count(1) AS query_count,sum(r.count) AS stream_thread_count, substring(a.query,0,50) AS query_str FROM ( SELECT query_id,node_name,remote_name,count(*), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY query_id,node_name ORDER BY count DESC) as rn FROM pgxc_comm_send_stream GROUP BY query_id,node_name, remote_name  ) r LEFT JOIN pgxc_stat_activity a ON r.query_id = a.query_id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND unique_sql_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,8 ORDER BY 1 ASC,7 DESC LIMIT 20;
